content.text: Two wakings at 19 months is really common, so you're not behind. Try this tonight: when he wakes, pause a minute or two to see if he resettles himself. If he doesn't, go in, keep it dull and quiet, and say the same short line each time ("night night, it's sleep time"). Don't turn the light on, and don't pick him up or feed him if that isn't how he fell asleep. Doing it the same way every wake is what teaches him he can get back to sleep on his own.
